events.description:
Hear a story about Jesus, discover that story for ourselves, and enjoy a hot chocolate!

Full of fun and energy, experience Church in a new way that is accessible to the young and beyond.

events.description:
Worship, prayer, and learning from God's Word.

Afterwards, we stay to fellowship, providing a light sandwich tea from 5pm.

events.title: Men's Curry Night
events.description:
Come and enjoy a relaxed evening of takeaway curry with the men of Coopers Edge Community Church.

Let us know what you'd like to order from Polash ahead of time, and we'll pick it up and have everything ready for 7:30pm. Drinks will be provided.

Please bring cash to pay for the meal you've selected.
